name: gridsense
description: GridSense: IoT monitoring and control (NestJS API + Next.js dashboard + MQTT)

scripts.dev: npm run dev:api & npm run dev:web & wait
scripts.build: npm run build -w @gridsense/api && npm run build -w @gridsense/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @gridsense/api && npm run lint -w @gridsense/web
scripts.infra:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d db mqtt
